Manage interactive SSH certificates.

## Synopsis

```
ssoossh ssh [command] [flags]
```

## Global options

Inherited from [`ssoossh`](/ssoossh/reference/cli/ssoossh/) and its parents.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-c`, `--config` | string |  | path to the ssoossh config file |
| `--server` | string |  | server address including scheme (e.g. "https://example.com") assumes https if omited. |
| `-v`, `--verbose` | count | `0` | trace what the command is doing, to stderr; repeat for more (-v steps, -vv requests and files, -vvv bodies) |

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`ssoossh ssh config`](/ssoossh/reference/cli/ssoossh/ssh-config/) | Print the ssh_config lines that hook ssoossh into your existing ssh. |
| [`ssoossh ssh inspect`](/ssoossh/reference/cli/ssoossh/ssh-inspect/) | Print details of the currently held ssoossh certificate(s). |
| [`ssoossh ssh login`](/ssoossh/reference/cli/ssoossh/ssh-login/) | Authenticate via OIDC and load a signed SSH certificate into the agent (or files). |
| [`ssoossh ssh logout`](/ssoossh/reference/cli/ssoossh/ssh-logout/) | Remove ssoossh-managed keys and certificates from the agent (or files). |
| [`ssoossh ssh proxycommand`](/ssoossh/reference/cli/ssoossh/ssh-proxycommand/) | Ensure a valid certificate, then relay stdio to the target host over TCP. |
